name: gremlins-inc-web
description: 《Gremlins, Inc.》网页复刻版 - 局域网联机，可移植移动端

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && node server/dist/index.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w client && cap sync
